text:
maya: CI smoke failing on the a6000 pool — shard 7 red. test=decoder_smoke.py::test_basic_decode. Node logs show GPU OOM then a kernel/driver hang. anyone around?
ci-bot: CI failure summary: job=smoke-shard-7, status=FAIL, exit=137, retries=1. logs: https://ci.internal/reports/1978429876
jake: can you paste the last ~50 lines of the pod logs? suspect driver mismatch or memory regression.
maya: pasted minimal dump below:
```
[2026-03-17T09:12:21Z] terminate called after throwing an instance of 'thrust::system_error'
[2026-03-17T09:12:21Z]   what():  an illegal memory access was encountered
[2026-03-17T09:12:22Z] CudaError: out of memory. GPU: 0 (a6000)
[2026-03-17T09:12:22Z] driver: 525.60, cuda runtime: 11.8, container image cuda-toolkit:11.8
[2026-03-17T09:12:23Z] NVRM: Xid 43, GPU has fallen off the bus.
[2026-03-17T09:12:23Z] killing process 31245 (pytest) with signal 9
```
sam: hmm looks like a hang (Xid 43) + OOM. the driver/runtime combo might be fine, but kernel bump yesterday could have destabilized the driver module. @anita did we roll kernel or driver last night?
anita: we pushed kernel 5.15.0-102 to the a6000 nodes at ~02:00 for the security patch. driver package stayed the same (525.60). no driver upgrade.
leo: quick try: reduce smoke batch size and rerun just shard 7 to confirm pure OOM vs kernel bug. set SMOKE_BATCH=1 and collect kernel logs.
maya: @leo please queue rerun with that env var and add --collect-kernel-logs. also tag node name when it starts.
leo: rerun queued: ci-bot queued job #1978429901 rerun-shard-7 (SMOKE_BATCH=1).
ci-bot: Rerun started on node gpu-a6000-03. driver=525.60, kernel=5.15.0-102, allocating 24GB RAM.
jake: if rerun passes then we have a workload regression; if it fails with same Xid it's infra. either way, bisect kernel vs driver next.
ci-bot: Rerun finished: status=FAIL, exit=137. pod logs show repeated OOM and kernel messages. snippet:
```
[2026-03-17T09:18:02Z] NVRM: Xid 43, GPU 0000:3b:00.0: GPU has fallen off the bus.
[2026-03-17T09:18:02Z] Out of memory. Unable to allocate 6144 MiB of GPU memory.
```
sam: that's a hard hang +oom. we should capture dmesg and nvidia-installer logs from gpu-a6000-03. @anita can you grab and upload?
anita: captured dmesg + /var/log/nvidia-installer.log, packaged at /tmp/a6000-shard7-1978429876.tar.gz and uploaded to infra bucket. starting a small kernel pin test: will provision 3 nodes with the previous kernel 5.15.0-98 and queue the smoke there.
maya: thanks — created a short incident thread in #incidents and linked the logs. adding follow-up: priority=high, action=bisect kernel -> if still failing, try driver rollback.
jake: i'll open infra ticket with logs and add the label. if infra can repro on pinned-kernel nodes we can decide rollback vs hotfix. :thumbsup:
maya: for now leaving shard 7 failing but tracked. thanks everyone for quick checks.
